Fixes from a live demo of the TLA frontier on this branch (real retained evidence copied from R2, 1,120 of 1,200 matches reused, nothing played). Jack Heart (2026-11-12): "sure" to steering these in. Must fix before v0.3.0:
1. A lost rental never ends: w160l8 lost its machine, its state.json was never written, so `observe` reports it running, `run.ended` is False and `Final(job=w160l8)` is a gap forever. manabot joined the launcher's record (`with_launcher_ends`); Etude should know a run whose attempt's rental is gone has ended (failed), from records it already keeps, so a failed job's Final is its last stored checkpoint as documented.
2. No way to say "trained checkpoints only": at-or-before half running_hours picks u0 for the earliest points; the old file refused initialization as a half-time partner. Give relative seats a way to exclude the line's initial checkpoint (e.g. positions strictly above 0 on a step clock, or a flag), with "no trained predecessor" a never-gap.
3. The built-in clocks silently vanish when attempt records (metrics/WRITER.json) are absent: old checkpoints then get no running_hours/hours_since_start and seats on those clocks resolve to nothing with no error or note. Derive from what checkpoint records hold, or put a note on the page saying why.
Also: 4. Benchmark names reject spaces (`^\S+$`) while seating names allow them; make them agree. 5. With `perf=()` / `ml=()` the Perf/ML sections still render headers and X axis controls; hide empty sections. 6. A narrow y range repeats tick labels ("0.51" twice); fix tick formatting. 7. `evaluation()` requires `max_hours` with an opaque ValidationError; give it a documented default or a clear message.
8. Rename page.py `Held` to the page's `Point` (graphical word; Jack Heart asked "what is a class Held(Record):", and it is the slot idea under another name): a position, a score or a gap with its reason. Resolve which matches score it before the chart, so `pairs`/`tournament` do not reach charts.js; drop `meta` in favour of rendering `missing`.
Demo files (for reproducing): /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-jack-src-etude-exp-45-let-a-repository/4c488b9c-27a7-4684-b60f-9487ebaf3efb/scratchpad/frontier/ (demo/tla_frontier.py, evidence/, page/).
